text: Winamax is a French gambling company (online poker and sports betting), incorporated as an unlisted SA à conseil d'administration (SIREN 492155932, RCS Paris), led by Alexandre Roos (président du conseil d'administration, directeur général) and Christophe Schaming (directeur général); no state or fund shareholder identified.
short: Winamax is a private French SA; no state or fund shareholder identified.
